_comment: Pokedex metadata for generating sprites. id -> {name, slug, generation, [sprite_size: 32|64], [base_form], [facing: left|right|front], [form_filter: regex]}. slug follows existing pokemon-data.ts key conventions (lowercase, punctuation stripped). facing describes the SOURCE sprite (default left = mirrored so the output faces right). form_filter limits which <id>-<form>.png variants are generated (e.g. Alcremie).
